SQLite WebAssembly build (@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm 3.53.4-build1, SQLite 3.53.4)
https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite-wasm — https://sqlite.org/wasm

The phone app uses it to keep its offline copy of the shop's data.

- SQLite itself is in the public domain (https://sqlite.org/copyright.html).
- The JavaScript glue code generated by Emscripten is covered by the MIT license and the
  University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
  (https://emscripten.org/docs/introducing_emscripten/emscripten_license.html).
- The npm packaging (@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm) is licensed under the Apache License 2.0
  (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
